races.paceDynamic: Road To Wembley, Maskarvel and Phantom Gold will ensure a strong gallop from the outset in this small field. Road To Wembley brings proven 2m1f class and Sean Bowen's tactical awareness, while Maskarvel has been consistent in similar company but carries less weight. The trio will stretch the field early, creating a searching test of stamina over Aintree's demanding hurdles track. This genuine pace heavily favours the hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces, particularly those with proven tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the three pace-setters maintain a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the stamina reserves of the leaders, allowing Red Nile and Into Battle to use their superior class ratings and finishing kicks. Both have the tactical speed to close from off the pace when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Road To Wembley Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Road To Wembley can control the pace and outlast his rivals
scenarios.body: Sean Bowen's tactical nous could see him dictate terms from the front, using his horse's proven 2m1f ability to stretch clear when the others weaken. His recent Aintree experience and higher weight rating give him the edge over fellow leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Maskarvel Outbattles Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Maskarvel's consistent form and weight advantage tells
scenarios.body: The lighter-weighted runner could prove toughest of the pace-setters, with Jonathan Burke able to sit just off Road To Wembley before striking. His regular placed efforts suggest he's overdue a win in this grade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jet Renegade Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and Jet Renegade finds his best form
scenarios.body: A messy tactical affair could suit the inconsistent hold-up runner if he recaptures his best efforts from earlier in the season. However, his poor recent form and trainer's current struggle make this unlikely.

races.paceDynamic: I C U In My Dreams will lead unopposed from the start, with no other confirmed front runners in this small field of eight. The prominent runners Magical Maggie, Atlantic City and Masked Dance will track behind but are unlikely to pressure the leader early over this extended 2m4f trip. This sets up a controlled pace that will build gradually, with the real action coming from the turn as the hold-up horses My Chiquita, Roaring Home, Mermaids Cave and Golden Glance attempt to close from off the pace. This tactical scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses who can time their challenges late against a vulnerable leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If I C U In My Dreams sets uncontested fractions and fades turning for home...
scenarios.body: The patient riders on My Chiquita, Roaring Home and Mermaids Cave will have perfectly timed their runs to sweep past a weakening leader. This plays directly into the strengths of the hold-up brigade who thrive when allowed to close late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Magical Maggie or Atlantic City press forward earlier than expected to put pressure on the leader...
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners seizes the initiative approaching two out and has enough left to hold off the late closers. The race becomes more genuinely run, suiting those who can combine early positioning with stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Maintains Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If I C U In My Dreams gets soft fractions and kicks clear before the field can organize...
scenarios.body: The front runner exploits the tactical nature of the race by stealing crucial lengths before the hold-up horses can respond. The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to find a winning turn of foot.
winners: I C U In My Dreams

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is exceptionally slow and the race becomes a sprint finish...
scenarios.body: The race turns into a messy affair where positioning and luck matter more than tactics. Any horse able to find racing room and maintain momentum could prevail in a blanket finish.

Roaring Home's jumping rhythm early - must travel smoothly to be effective in the closing stages
The overall pace through the first mile - if too slow it completely changes the tactical complexion

races.paceDynamic: The Flier Begley is the sole confirmed pace-setter and will dictate proceedings from the front without pressure, creating a sustainable gallop throughout the 2m4f trip. With seven prominent runners bunched behind including Parisencore, Southoftheborder, Bleu d'Enfer, Fringill Dike and Breizh River, the pace will be genuine but controlled rather than frantic. The three hold-up horses (Coastguard Station, My Noble Lord, Genois) will rely on the sustained gallop setting up their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick clear before the closers get organised.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Flier Begley maintains a solid gallop and the prominent brigade stay handy
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will suit those tracking just behind the leader, allowing them to strike before the back-markers can mount their challenge. Horses like Southoftheborder and Breizh River are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady in the middle sections allowing closers to get into contention
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure would enable the hold-up horses to close the gap and unleash their finishing speed in the final furlong. Genois and My Noble Lord have the class and finishing kick to capitalise on such circumstances.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If The Flier Begley finds the sustained pace suits his stamina and stays clear
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead could prove decisive if the chasers fail to coordinate their challenges effectively. The 11-year-old's experience at Aintree and lack of early pressure would play into his hands perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: A tactical affair would completely change the complexion, potentially favouring horses with the best turn of foot regardless of position. This would be the least likely outcome given The Flier Begley's front-running style but could suit the classier animals.

races.paceDynamic: Fingal's Hill will set the pace from the front with no obvious challengers for the early lead, creating a controlled tempo throughout. The prominent runners Brewin'upastorm, Static, Lightningupourdays and Luttrell Lad will track behind but won't apply significant early pressure. With a large contingent of hold-up horses including Rambo T, Smokeringinthedark, El Galactico, Ike Sport, Last Kingdom and Break Point, the race will develop into a steady gallop building to a finish where stamina and tactical positioning matter most. This sustainable pace and competitive finish strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Fingal's Hill maintains a steady tempo without significant early pressure from the prominent pack.
scenarios.body: The veteran gets an uncontested lead and can dictate terms, while the hold-up brigade face a wall of horses in the straight. Front-runners and prominent racers benefit from cleaner runs and avoided traffic.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as fresh legs sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Class horses with finishing kicks capitalise on over-generous fractions set by Fingal's Hill.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Brewin'upastorm or Static apply enough pressure to prevent Fingal's Hill from getting too comfortable.
scenarios.body: The race becomes truly run with early positioning crucial, favouring those who can sit handy without doing too much work. The prominent horses get first run on the leader while avoiding the hold-up traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Fingal's Hill goes too slowly and creates a messy sprint finish with traffic problems.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning and racing room decisive rather than merit. Horses drawn well or finding gaps benefit while better horses get trapped.

races.paceDynamic: Bumpy Evans and Taxus Baccata will contest the early lead, with Bumpy Evans likely to take them along at a strong gallop given his recent aggressive front-running form. Four runners (Calimystic, Erne River, Loughderg Rocco, My Bobby Dazzler) all want prominent positions, creating serious traffic problems approaching the business end. The sustained pace from the dual leaders will stretch the field, but the prominent congestion means positioning battles will be crucial 3-4 furlongs out. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver their challenge late when the pace casualties emerge.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The strong gallop from Bumpy Evans and Taxus Baccata will find out the prominent brigade, while clean runs from the back prove decisive. Late-closers can sweep past tiring pace-setters and congested prominent runners.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Bumpy Evans or Taxus Baccata gets loose on the front end
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the prominent runners mark each other out of it. The hold-up horses have too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and stop quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between whoever avoided the early pace battle. Mid-division runners who stayed out of trouble inherit the race.
